item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i nad sel sman gyi sgrub thabs rnam par rgyal ba'i sman sdong
item.coloph: ces 'di nyid gsang bdag rig 'dzin gar dbang bdud 'dul rtsal dang*/ snying grogs bdud 'dul rtsal dang*/ snying grogs dam pa bon sgo 'di la mos shing skye ba sngon nas dam tshig gi spun grogs su gyur ba bslab gsum shes rab kyis phyug pa'i dge rgan sa trig sam sad kyis ring mo'i dus nas bskul ba dang / phyis su bu slob bla chung g.yung drung bstan dbang dang yang slob btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs kyis tshe gos dkar po yug ring gis sna drangs nas bskul ba la brten nas/ 'chi med mu la sgron gsal gyi rol gar lung du grags pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am dbyings kyi gsang mtshan g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyi zhal lung dngos su thob bzhin dus dang skabs su bab nas spel ba 'dis kyang / 'gro kun zug ngu nad kyis gdung ba grol zhing rang rig bdag zhal mthong ba'i rgyur gyur cig bkra shis bde legs nam mkha'i mtha' khyab shog lcags bya zla 12 tshes 22 la'o//
